title: Mr. Mustard, Polythene Pam & She Came In Through The Bathroom Window
lyrics_synced:
[00:04.80] Mean Mister Mustard sleeps in the park.
[00:08.38] Shaves in the dark trying to save paper.
[00:14.41] Sleeps in a hole in the road.
[00:19.22] Saving up to buy some clothes.
[00:24.02] Keeps a tenbob note up his nose.
[00:28.18] Such a mean old man!
[00:33.02] Such a mean old man!
[00:38.41] His sister Pam works in a shop.
[00:41.97] She never stops, she's a gogetter.
[00:48.03] Takes him out to look at the queen.
[00:52.82] Only place that he's ever been.

[01:01.77] Such a dirty old man!
[01:06.00] Dirty old man!

[01:17.22] Well, you sho-uld see her in drag dressed
[01:18.45] in her polythene bag.
[01:19.21] Yes, you should see Polythene Pam.
[01:21.60] Yeah, yeah, yeah!

[01:29.22] She's a killerdiller when
[01:29.98] she's dress-ed to the hilt.

[01:35.60] yeah, yeah, yeah!

[02:10.79] protected by a silver spoon.
[02:16.98] But now she sucks her thumb and wonders
[02:21.81] by the banks of her own lagoon.
[02:25.98] Didn't anybody tell her?
[02:32.12] Didn't anybody see?

[02:44.09] Tuesdays on the phone to me.
